title: GoCoreStyleConfig
description: Configuration schema for Go Core Philosophy & Style static checks and LLM linter assertions.

enforce_line_of_sight.description: Require early guard clauses and left-aligned happy path control flow.

wrap_errors_with_w.description: Enforce fmt.Errorf wrapping using %w for dynamic error annotations.

accept_interfaces_return_structs.description: Require constructors to return concrete struct pointers and consumers to define narrow interfaces.

disallow_interface_impl_suffixes.description: Prohibit Impl suffixes or Default prefixes in interface and struct names.

max_cyclomatic_complexity.description: Maximum allowed function complexity before requiring refactoring.
